_comment: Tier 2.6q — declarative placement. Designer writes intent (8-tree perimeter, 5-orb pentagon) instead of computing 8+5+12 hand-typed coordinates. Engine expands at load time via InstancePatterns.

patterns._comment: 5 orbs evenly spaced on a circle around the player at radius 5
8 trees forming the perimeter ring at radius 13
12 rocks scattered randomly in mid-area with min spacing so they don't overlap

initial_instances._: Singleton — hand-placed since patterns are for repeated objects
